reason: The patch adds `updatedAt` and `googleChannelId` to the selectedCalendars select in `findUnlockedUserForSession` (packages/lib/server/repository/user.ts:899-900) and widens the `UserWithCalendars` Pick type to match (getConnectedDestinationCalendars.ts:21-28).
